headline: Sanderson Farms Championship: Pro-Am wraps as Round 1 tee times locked
whyCareReason: Official Pro-Am wraps at Country Club of Jackson with defending champion Kevin Yu and Mackenzie Hughes featured as the FedExCup Fall officially tees off.
teaser: Wednesday 30 September: Pro-Am day concludes in Jackson, Mississippi. Featured morning groupings announced for Thursday's Round 1 as tour pros fight for 2027 survival.
story:
Why this one matters: Wednesday brought the official Pro-Am and final preparation to the Country Club of Jackson, putting the finishing touches on the stage for Thursday's Round 1 of the Sanderson Farms Championship.

The tournament marks the opening salvo of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Fall, where the stakes are existential. Defending champion Kevin Yu, whose playoff heroics here in 2024 launched his career into the top tier, returns to Jackson grouped alongside two-time tour winner Mackenzie Hughes and Emiliano Grillo for a 7:45 a.m. CT tee time.

With fast bermudagrass greens and clear Mississippi skies forecast for Thursday morning, early scoring will be vital. For competitors on the threshold of the top 125, the pressure starts with the opening drive on hole number one.
stakes: The winner earns a two-year PGA Tour exemption, entry into the Sentry and PGA Championship, and crucial FedExCup points.
rivalryAngle: High-stakes individual survival: fringe tour members versus seasoned veterans protecting their playing privileges.
